assessments.explanation: Chain 0 states a time-conditioned coordinate contrast hypothesis with named observables (soft_mass, local_dx), observed-node sign structure, and window restriction, giving an executable intervention hypothesis.
Chain 1 states a time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule restricted to the observed window tracking sign reversals, with falsifier and scope, satisfying the executable-hypothesis check.
Chain 2 states a time-conditioned coordinate contrast following observed sign reversal of named features, with observable, direction, scope and falsifier, forming an executable hypothesis.
Chain 3 states signed favorable-versus-comparison coordinate contrasts at observed selection nodes restricted to fidelity-passing features, with observable, direction, scope and falsifier.
Chain 4 states a time-conditioned regional attention recipe following validated soft-mass sign over the observed window, with observable, direction, scope and falsifier.
Chain 5 states a time-conditioned coordinate contrast rule using observed-node interpolation of named features, with observable, direction, scope and falsifier.
